workflows.title: Log a strength set and use the cross-area rest timer · desktop
steps: Log the prefilled second working set
Extend rest, switch to Today, and return using the timer link
checks: A fresh backend read contains exactly two Bench press sets
The timer survived area navigation, linked to the originating session, and cleared on Skip

workflows.title: Append a planned slot beside existing intake · desktop
steps: Log the planned 07:15 slot and inspect the append confirmation
checks: A fresh backend read contains three additional food snapshots and one additional logged meal
The planned slot remains visible and can be logged again

workflows.title: Create, edit and delete a journal entry · desktop
steps: Write a Markdown journal entry and save it
Edit the entry and save the changed title
Open the editor, confirm Delete, and return to the journal list
checks: The create form navigated to a detail route and a fresh backend read confirms its title
A fresh backend read confirms the edited title
A fresh backend read confirms deletion and the deleted detail is no longer displayed

steps: Select Light, inspect Today, then restore Dark
checks: The real theme control changed the document appearance and persisted across navigation
